name: automode
description: Routes coding work across models: Haiku explores, Opus plans and reviews, Sonnet builds and verifies. Also ships the Concise output style.

mode.title: AutoMode: Router mode
mode.description: default: follow config.json (auto as shipped). auto routes model and effort in every session. shadow only records what it would route. off does not route. AUTOMODE_ROUTER still wins.

policy.title: AutoMode: Routing policy
policy.description: default: follow config.json. auto: the effortless judges with the joint optimizer. legacy: the earlier rules. Applies while the mode is auto. AUTOMODE_POLICY still wins.

routeModels.title: AutoMode: Route models
routeModels.description: default: follow config.json. off routes effort only and keeps the model you picked.

subagentsEverySession.title: AutoMode: Subagents in every session
subagentsEverySession.description: default: follow config.json. on: built-in subagents are routed in every session, not only AutoMode (Explore on Haiku; general-purpose on Sonnet under Opus). An explicit model is always kept.

guardianMode.title: AutoMode: Guardian
guardianMode.description: default: follow config.json (auto as shipped). observe records only; recommend adds notes; assist adds checkpoints and one-key suggestions; auto may also pause, compact and shorten outputs where those are on. AUTOMODE_GUARDIAN still wins.

guardianEverySession.title: AutoMode: Guardian in every session
guardianEverySession.description: default: follow config.json. on: the guardian runs in every session, not only AutoMode.

hardPause.title: AutoMode: Hard pause
hardPause.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: a turn that does not converge is ended between requests, never mid-write.

autoCompact.title: AutoMode: Auto compact
autoCompact.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: compacts between turns when it pays; otherwise /compact is suggested.

reduceOutputs.title: AutoMode: Reduce long outputs
reduceOutputs.description: default: follow config.json. on, in guardian auto: long command output is saved in full and shortened in the chat, every error line kept.

layout.title: AutoMode: Layout
layout.description: expanded: the status bar above the prompt. minimal: one short line.

theme.title: AutoMode: Theme
theme.description: native (default): follows your Claude Code and editor theme, with no colours of its own. automode: blue routing, violet effort, teal guardian. mono: neutral accents. contrast: stronger text and edges.

appearance.title: AutoMode: Appearance
appearance.description: auto follows your Claude Code theme. dark and light fix it.

metrics.title: AutoMode: Bar metrics
metrics.description: Comma-separated bar items: pending, context, cache, cost, guardian, stage. The mode, model and effort always show.
